sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the conditional applicability dates and rejects both absence of the 2002 edition and any conflicting edition, while preserving the prior instruction not to impose unconditional date cardinalities. Deterministic validation is valid.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the unconditional sh:minCount 1 constraints on constructionContractDate and constructionStageDate unless the regulation independently requires those dates for every ship; they are applicability inputs, and the requirement only imposes the edition condition when both date conditions are met. Keep the date applicability test, and retain a positive violation check requiring nltl:applicableIceClassRegulationEdition to include exactly nltl:iceClassRegulationEdition2002 for ships meeting the condition, rejecting absence or a conflicting edition.

The candidate faithfully encodes the conditional applicability dates and rejects both absence of the 2002 edition and any conflicting edition, while preserving the prior instruction not to impose unconditional date cardinalities. Deterministic validation is valid.
